frontend.reasoning: SSR for SEO-critical profile pages, App Router for modern React patterns, built-in image optimization. Vercel edge functions can serve profiles at CDN edge.
frontend.reasoning_styling: Utility-first for rapid iteration. shadcn/ui gives accessible, copy-paste components that don't drift from upstream.

backend.reasoning: Keep monorepo simple. No separate backend needed for MVP. Server Actions handle form submissions securely.

database.reasoning: Built-in auth, real-time, row-level security. Free tier covers early stage. PostGIS for location-based search later.
database.reasoning_drizzle: Lighter than Prisma, better performance, TypeScript-first, SQL-like API that developers know.

auth.reasoning: Email/OAuth magic links, phone auth, social providers. RLS handles authorization automatically. Zero infra to manage.

hosting.reasoning: Zero-config Next.js deployment. Edge network for profile pages. Free tier generous. Auto HTTPS, CDN, previews on PRs.
hosting.fallback: Cloudflare Pages (if Vercel pricing becomes issue)

email.reasoning: Developer-first email API. React-based email templates. Free tier 3k emails/month. Better DX than SendGrid for this use case.

sms.reasoning: Industry standard, reliable, pay-as-you-go. Only needed for booking confirmations.

storage.reasoning: Built into Supabase ecosystem. Good for business logos, photos. RLS integrates with auth.

monitoring.reasoning: Free tier generous, integrates with Vercel, great error grouping.

alternatives_evaluated.prisma: Rejected: heavier runtime, slower cold starts on serverless, larger bundle.
alternatives_evaluated.nhost: Rejected: smaller community than Supabase, less proven at scale.
alternatives_evaluated.Firebase: Rejected: vendor lock-in, weaker SQL experience, NoSQL limits complex queries.
alternatives_evaluated.Strapi: Rejected: self-hosted = more ops overhead, contradicts 'low maintenance' goal.
alternatives_evaluated.Astro: Evaluated but rejected: better for content sites, worse for booking/CRM interactivity.

mvp_scope.reasoning: High volume, recurring appointments, visual-first, price-sensitive (need simple tool). Clear ICP for early feedback.
features_v1: Public profile page with business info, hours, services, photos
features_v2: Client CRM with history and notes

architecture_notes.profile_page: SSR via Next.js App Router. Each business gets /business/{slug}. JSON-LD injected for AI indexing. Schema.org LocalBusiness + BarberShop types.
architecture_notes.database_schema: Tables: businesses, users, services, bookings, reviews. RLS policies per business. PostGIS for 'near me' queries.
architecture_notes.seo_strategy: Full SSR for profile pages. Dynamic sitemaps. Open Graph tags per business. JSON-LD for AI agent consumption.
